cases.oracle: Guest-only compiled two-thread tracee uses a FIFO gate, creates both threads before attachment, explicitly authorizes only the tracer PID with PR_SET_PTRACER, then issues known getpid/getppid calls and exits without signals. Guest setup runs parser controls and a native sibling ptrace tracer against an independently owned tracee, checking both calls and both natural exits; any native preflight failure is setup ERROR. Each candidate run independently checks parentage, live task IDs, no prior tracer, and samples per-thread TracerPid before gate release. A separate owner records actual tracee exit and raw output.
cases.purpose: Attach to an already-running owned process and trace until it exits naturally.
cases.comparison: Require independently established leader attachment before release, leader getpid and exit trace records, natural fixture status and both fixture markers, successful tracer status and empty candidate stdout.
cases.candidate_script:
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/strace-attach-reviewed.py launch "$$" >"$HOME/supervisor.out" 2>"$HOME/supervisor.err" &
supervisor=$!
if ! /usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/strace-attach-reviewed.py prepare "$supervisor" "$$" >"$HOME/prepare.out" 2>"$HOME/prepare.err"; then
  wait "$supervisor" 2>/dev/null || :
  exit 97
fi
read -r fixture_pid < "$HOME/fixture.pid"
ulimit -f 512 || exit 97
rc=0
strace -p "$fixture_pid" >"$HOME/candidate.out" 2>"$HOME/candidate.err" || rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$rc" >"$HOME/candidate.status"
wait "$supervisor" 2>/dev/null || :
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/strace-attach-reviewed.py verify r1
